description: This file provides TypeScript type definitions and interface declarations for Node.js's 'stream' module, including classes like Stream, Readable, Writable, Duplex, Transform, and related utility functions. It defines the shapes of various stream classes, methods, events, and options for type-checking and IntelliSense support in TypeScript projects.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Abstract base class for built-in and custom streams implementing the basic event-emitter interface.

classes.name: Readable
classes.description: Class representing a readable stream of data, with methods for consuming and transforming data streams.

classes.name: Writable
classes.description: Class representing a writable stream, with methods for writing data and managing backpressure.

classes.name: Duplex
classes.description: Class that combines Readable and Writable interfaces, representing streams that are both readable and writable.

classes.name: Transform
classes.description: A Duplex stream that transforms data passing through it.

classes.name: PassThrough
classes.description: A simple Transform stream that passes data through without transforming.

methods.name: duplexPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of interconnected Duplex streams that act like connected ends of a network connection.

methods.name: addAbortSignal
methods.description: Attaches an AbortSignal to a stream to control stream destruction via abort events.
